why: I checked both must_not items against the verifier's checks and the builder brief. Item 1 holds: Check 3 runs every exported function through a heading regex and must print ALL PRESENT. The PASS text names slugify, "which had no section before this change", so a README with only a padLeft section would print MISSING: slugify and fail. Item 2 holds: Checks 1 and 2 only test left padding, the default space fill, exact width and returning s unchanged, using fill values of one character or none. Multi-character fill is "advisory… do not fail on it", and nothing counts parameters. Check 3's regex takes any heading level from # to ######, with or without a backtick, and does not require the `## name(args)` form. That form appears only as builder guidance, not as a PASS/FAIL condition. Asking for content under each heading is a fair reading of "a section". Check 4 needs only exit code 0 and fail 0.
